items.summary: The Trump administration has approved Elon Musk's plan to build datacentres in space, authorizing the launch of one million Starmind orbital satellites built by SpaceX to process data off Earth. The US federal regulators granted this approval as part of the initiative. Supporters argue that processing AI data in orbit would be more energy-efficient and reduce the environmental impact of terrestrial datacentres amid rapid growth in the AI industry. However, questions remain about how realistic the plan is and what consequences it could have.
items.title: Trump Administration Approves Elon Musk's Plan for Space-Based AI Datacentres

items.summary: Cybersecurity firm Push Security has tracked an ongoing phishing campaign called GoodGuys since October 13, which impersonates major brands—including Accenture, American Express, Coca-Cola, Culver's, Google Cloud, Nvidia, SpaceX, and Spotify—to harvest corporate Google and Okta credentials. The attacks lure recipients with fake invitations to paid expert interviews or webinars offering up to $600 for a 45-minute interview (with the Nvidia site advertising $500 for an AI feedback study), prompting victims to sign in with their work accounts. Threat actors abuse legitimate email and event platforms such as HireVue, SendGrid, Mandrill, and Cvent to distribute phishing links hosted on brand-themed subdomains like accenture[international-interviews][.]com and nvidia[feedback-study][.]com. Clicking these links typically triggers a CAPTCHA challenge before landing on a branded page that ultimately requests Google or Okta sign-in; the kit rejects Gmail, Yahoo, and Outlook addresses to target corporate accounts specifically. Unlike adversary-in-the-middle kits that relay legitimate login pages via reverse proxies, GoodGuys uses attacker-controlled fake authentication forms that can present multifactor challenges such as SMS codes, authenticator codes, and push notifications from Google or Okta Verify; researchers believe the actors manually attempt logins using stolen credentials while the page mirrors whatever security prompts appear. Push Security suspects an AI coding assistant was used to build the kit, based on hidden accessibility labels reading
items.title: GoodGuys phishing campaign impersonates brands to steal Google and Okta credentials

items.summary: Tesla has deployed 29 temporary (mobile) Supercharger stalls across four of its busiest stations—Firebaugh, CA (+10), Bakersfield, CA Olive Dr (+8), Bakersfield, CA Copus Rd (+4), and Holbrook, AZ (+7)—to handle the Thanksgiving travel rush. These mobile additions sit on top of 1,027 permanent stalls Tesla says it opened across 91 US sites in the last 56 days (roughly 18 per day). The push is accompanied by on-site attendants to manage queues and a virtual waitlist now live at 300 sites. Three of the four mobile-stall locations are in California's Central Valley, where holiday Supercharger lines have been chronic; Copus Rd had already received free off-peak charging offers since 2021, while Holbrook is an Arizona outlier on I-40 with few alternatives.
items.title: Tesla deploys 29 mobile Supercharger stalls for Thanksgiving travel rush

items.summary: Pablo Hernández de Cos, a former Bank of Spain governor and current general manager of the Bank for International Settlements, has been chosen as the next president of the European Central Bank, defeating his rival Klaas Knot. He will become the first Spaniard to lead the institution and take up office after Christine Lagarde steps down in February 2027 — though this text states he is expected to succeed her upon departure rather than specifying a fixed date. The appointment was part of a package deal that also secured two executive board seats: France's Laurence Boone and Germany's Markus Brunnermeier, with European Council president António Costa confirming all three nominations as paving the way for formal confirmation by the EUCO in December.
items.title: Spain's Pablo Hernández de Cos Wins Race to Lead the ECB

items.summary: Shares of Redington Ltd rose more than 5% on Thursday after reports that Apple Inc would open a retail store in Hyderabad. The stock climbed 5.28% to Rs 341.45, up from the previous close of Rs 324.30. Redington supplies vendors including Apple Inc, Dell, HP, and Microsoft.
items.title: Redington shares rise over 5% on reports of Apple store in Hyderabad

items.summary: A CBS News investigation reported that at least two California-based companies controlled by Chinese-owned firms have been purchasing Nvidia's most advanced artificial intelligence chips, maintaining business relationships with the chipmaker despite questions about their ownership structures. RiCloud AI, based in San Jose and listed as an Nvidia 'preferred partner' for priority access to advanced chips and support, is owned by Yuxing InfoTech Investment Holdings of Shenzhen; corporate records cited by CBS show its CEO Cong Yu holds a degree from the People's Liberation Army Command College. Another California company, Aivres—listed as Nvidia's highest-tier 'elite' computing partner and formerly known as Inspur after its Chinese parent was placed on a US government security blacklist in 2023—is also implicated. The investigation found that some of these companies leased or sold advanced Nvidia-powered servers to businesses in Southeast Asia; trade records cited by the report show Aivres exported at least $5.6 billion worth of advanced technology, including Blackwell-chip servers, to Southeast Asia between April 2024 and February 2026. The investigation was conducted with research support from C4ADS, a Washington-based security nonprofit that examined corporate filings and ownership records.
items.title: CBS Report Finds Chinese-Controlled California Firms Buy Nvidia's Most Advanced AI Chips

items.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India has received a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the Reserve Bank of India to introduce futures contracts on corporate bond indices, following an earlier NOC from the Securities and Exchange Board of India that allows the contracts to operate under its regulatory framework. The proposed fixed income product is aimed at providing market participants with an exchange-traded instrument to manage corporate bond market risk and support development of the broader corporate bond derivatives ecosystem in India. Corporate bond index futures are expected to offer additional avenues for risk management, portfolio hedging and price discovery, while also supporting market making by allowing participants to manage risks arising from their corporate bond portfolios. The initiative is expected to help bridge the gap between the expanding underlying bond market and the availability of efficient exchange-traded risk-management instruments. NSE targets institutional demand for hedging tools, with a focus on credit spreads alongside interest rates.
items.title: NSE Secures RBI Approval for Corporate Bond Index Futures

items.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India announced Thursday that it had received a no-objection certificate from the Reserve Bank to introduce futures contracts on corporate bond indices, marking a new derivatives product in the country's fixed-income market. The approval follows NSE receiving a similar clearance from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) for launching the contracts under the prescribed regulatory framework. In its statement, NSE said it would undertake operational preparations to introduce the contracts according to applicable regulations, with details on contract specifications and trading commencement to be announced separately. The proposed Corporate Bond Index Futures are expected to provide market participants with a transparent, standardized exchange-traded instrument for managing exposure to corporate bond valuation movements, including changes from interest rates and credit spreads. NSE said the products would facilitate portfolio-level hedging, allow directional views on the corporate bond market, support more efficient portfolio management, complement the growing ecosystem of fixed-income ETFs and other passive debt investment products, and promote greater transparency, broader participation, and improved efficiency in India's corporate bond market. Sriram Krishnan, NSE Chief Business Development Officer, stated that introducing Corporate Bond Index Futures would be another important step toward bridging the gap between the growing underlying bond market and efficient exchange-traded investment and risk-management instruments.
items.title: NSE Receives RBI Approval for Corporate Bond Index Futures

items.summary: The Jen-Hsun & Lori Huang Foundation saw the value of its Nvidia stock holdings jump by roughly $2.3 billion in a single day when Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and shares rose more than 30% to close at $165.05 on Monday, per Fortune citing Nvidia's 2026 proxy statement. The foundation holds approximately 59 million Nvidia shares, pushing the value of its stake to roughly $9.7 billion — up from Friday's (November 20) closing price. Lori Huang has served as president since 2014 while Jensen serves as secretary and CFO; she is also co-trustee of family trusts holding most of the couple's shares, part of a personal fortune Forbes valued at roughly $144 billion. The foundation's assets grew from $828 million at end-2020 to $9.2 billion by end-2024 per tax filings, and FoundationMark ranked it among the 15 largest US private foundations in 2024 alongside the Rockefeller and Conrad N. Hilton Foundations. Recent gifts include $75 million to Vanderbilt University (July), a $5 million annual commitment to the San Francisco Opera, $22.5 million to California College of the Arts (2025), and $50 million to Oregon State University (2022). In 2024, $82 million of its $126 million payout went to DAFgiving360 (formerly Schwab Charitable); in 2023 a $46 million contribution to a Schwab DAF accounted for 77% of total disbursements. The charity has no website and reported no paid staff as of 2023, yet the Huangs continue transferring shares into it — including 440,000 Nvidia shares (around $60 million) from their living trust in June 2025.
items.title: Jensen Huang's Foundation Gained $2.3B in a Day as Nvidia Stock Surged
